description: Allowed parameter keys and value ranges for synthetic policy generation. Generation scripts sample or assign values within these bounds per company.

annual_leave_days.description: Paid annual leave days for full-time employees.

probation_months.description: Months before full leave entitlement applies.

carry_forward_limit.description: Maximum unused leave days carried to the next year.

sick_leave_days.description: Paid sick leave days per year.

remote_days_per_week.description: Maximum work-from-home days allowed per week.

core_hours_start.description: Start of daily core collaboration hours (local time).

core_hours_end.description: End of daily core collaboration hours (local time).

equipment_allowance_usd.description: One-time or annual home office equipment stipend in USD.

reporting_window_days.description: Days allowed to report an incident after it occurs.

training_frequency_months.description: Months between mandatory conduct training sessions.

whistleblower_hotline.description: Whether a confidential whistleblower hotline is available.

health_insurance_coverage_pct.description: Employer share of employee health insurance premium.

dental_coverage_pct.description: Employer share of dental insurance premium.

retirement_match_pct.description: 401(k) or pension match percentage of salary.

waiting_period_days.description: Days after start date before benefits enrollment.

expense_reimbursement_days.description: Business days to reimburse approved expenses.

max_single_expense_usd.description: Maximum single expense claim without pre-approval.

receipt_required_above_usd.description: Minimum expense amount requiring a receipt.

probation_months.description: Initial probation period before first formal review.

rating_scale_max.description: Top numeric rating on the performance scale.

pip_duration_days.description: Standard performance improvement plan duration in days.

onboarding_duration_days.description: Structured onboarding program length in business days.

buddy_program_weeks.description: Weeks a new hire is paired with an onboarding buddy.

it_provisioning_days.description: Target days to provision laptop and system access.

notice_period_days.description: Required notice period for voluntary resignation.

severance_weeks_per_year.description: Severance weeks granted per year of service.

exit_interview_required.description: Whether an exit interview is mandatory for departing employees.

password_min_length.description: Minimum password length for corporate accounts.

device_encryption_required.description: Whether full-disk encryption is required on company devices.

phishing_training_frequency_months.description: Months between mandatory security awareness trainings.

per_diem_usd.description: Daily meal and incidental allowance for domestic travel.

max_hotel_rate_usd.description: Maximum nightly hotel rate without manager approval.

advance_booking_days.description: Minimum days before travel to book flights for standard fares.

economy_class_max_hours.description: Flight duration in hours below which economy class is required.
